Hi all — technical and commercial notes below. Apologies for the delay — needed to confirm storage/backfill options with infra.

Technical plan (what we can deliver):
- Point-in-time snapshot: we can create a consistent snapshot of request traces and audit logs at a chosen cutover timestamp. Exports delivered as compressed Parquet to Catalyst's S3 bucket.
- Immutable retention: we will enable object lock on the audit-bucket at Catalyst's request for the requested 12-month retention window. This requires a signed amendment to the retention clause.
- Export window: recommend a 72-hour export window with a rolling stream to S3 to avoid double-storage. For large tenants we can also perform a background bulk export with rate limits to avoid QPS impact.
- Items included: API request logs, token-level audit logs, admin-activity logs, and per-route latency traces. Metrics and dashboards will be exported as CSV.

Commercial / timing:
- Retention delta: storage & immutability surcharge estimated at +$1,900/month (this covers object-lock overhead and compliance operationalization).
- Burst capacity: we can provide a temporary 30% burst for up to two weeks; pricing for the burst is a one-time charge of $6,200 to cover GPU allocation and scheduling. We can reduce to 15% / one-week if procurement prefers a smaller uplift (pro-rated).
- Contract changes: propose a 15-month renewal term (one-time) to align renewal timing with their audit cadence and absorb part of the retention cost in a blended unit price. I can draft the amendment language for the retention and transient capacity clause.
- Timeline: if Catalyst signs the MAP by Sep 25, we can start evidence staging Oct 3 and complete export by Oct 10 (audit kickoff Oct 12).
